about: Plugins the online catalogue marks Experimental. build_catalog.py adds "experimental": true and the
"tested" note to their entries in index.json, and shows an Experimental tag and the note on the
catalogue page. Their manifests, and so their zips, don't change. A plugin is listed when it has only
been tested against stand-ins for the service or device it works with, or when a run against the real
one found problems that aren't fixed yet. "source" starts with the file in the repository that says
so; it isn't published. Take a plugin off the list once it works against the real thing, and update
the tested section of its README at the same time.

dev.perritodeck.gitlab.tested: Tested against a stand-in for the GitLab API, not yet with a real GitLab.

dev.perritodeck.http.tested: Tested against a test server on the same computer, not yet with real web services.

dev.perritodeck.hue.tested: Tested against a stand-in for a Hue Bridge, not yet with real Hue lights.

dev.perritodeck.keylight.tested: Tested against stand-in lights, not yet with a real Key Light or Light Strip.

dev.perritodeck.mqtt.tested: Tested against a stand-in MQTT broker, not yet with a real one such as Mosquitto.

dev.perritodeck.ollama.tested: Tested against a stand-in for Ollama, not yet with a real Ollama.

dev.perritodeck.proxmox.tested: Tested against a stand-in for the Proxmox VE API, not yet with a real server.

dev.perritodeck.spotify.tested: Tested against a stand-in for Spotify, not yet with the real Spotify service.

dev.perritodeck.truenas.tested: Tested against a stand-in for the TrueNAS API, not yet with a real TrueNAS.

dev.perritodeck.twitch.tested: Tested against stand-ins for Twitch's sign-in, API and live events, not yet with real Twitch.

dev.perritodeck.uptime.tested: Tested against test servers on the same computer, not yet with real websites and hosts.

dev.perritodeck.weather.tested: Tested against a stand-in for Open-Meteo, not yet with the live service.

dev.perritodeck.wol.tested: Tested by catching the wake-up packet on the same computer, not yet by waking a real one.
